children: U.S. selected services revenue rose 3.0% to $6,418.7B in Q2 2026 from +1.1% to $6,231.3B in Q1 2026, according to data released by the U.S. Census Bureau on Wednesday.
According to the Q2 initial reading, growth had stood at 3.1% to $6,421.9B.
